TC-14/S22.title: Encounter tab, notepad and Post-Round note pass axe
TC-14/S22.detail: Not run on 8b4be94a: the visual spec seeds charts with a stored note and a billing template (soap / snf-progress), which queues the server billing job that would reach Bedrock on the local stack (RULES: never store a billing-template note locally). A copy with a 'Procedure / other' template was not written. Our own accessibility check (P2), suggestion only. The Nursing Home pre-round opener did gain a name on this build (A1 partly addressed).
